description:
List wallet transactions

Returns movements on the prepaid wallet, newest first: top-ups, charges and manual adjustments, each with the balance that resulted. The `pagination` block echoes the `page` and `perPage` that were used and carries `total`, a real count of the movements on the wallet, so the number of pages can be worked out before fetching them.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.
